dossier.headline: October inflation breaches the RBI's 6% ceiling
dossier.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October from 5.54% in September, the highest since October 2024 and above the 5.93% consensus. Food inflation rose to 8.94%, led by onion prices up 116% year on year. On November 13 the print was cited for softness in Indian stocks, with rate-sensitive realty and autos the weakest sectors.
why_it_matters: It is the first breach of the RBI's upper tolerance band since October 2024
The RBI raised rates in October, so the print raises the stakes for further tightening
